content: Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is a reputable, Gujarat-based chemical manufacturing and trading enterprise headquartered in the vibrant industrial city of Vadodara (formerly Baroda), Gujarat—India’s powerhouse of chemical and pharmaceutical innovation. Established with a steadfast commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, the company operates from its strategically located office and operational hub at 102 Sudhan Apartment, opposite Tejas School on Race Course Road, Vadodara – 390007. Situated in the heart of Gujarat’s chemical corridor—proximal to major ports, industrial zones, and R&D institutions—Minol leverages its prime location to ensure efficient logistics, quick turnaround times, and robust customer responsiveness. The company specializes in the supply of high-purity industrial acids—including sulfuric acid, hydrochloric acid, nitric acid, phosphoric acid—and a broad spectrum of specialty chemicals, reagents, and formulated solutions catering to diverse sectors such as electroplating, metal finishing, water treatment, textile processing, battery manufacturing, and laboratory research. Compliant with national regulatory frameworks—including the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) guidelines and relevant provisions of the Chemical Rules, 2017—Minol adheres to stringent quality control protocols, safe handling practices, and responsible stewardship of hazardous substances. Backed by technically trained personnel, certified storage infrastructure, and client-centric service ethos, Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. has earned the trust of SMEs, medium-scale industries, and institutional laboratories across Western and Central India. With an unwavering focus on integrity, technical excellence, and ethical business practices, the company continues to grow as a dependable partner in Gujarat’s dynamic chemical ecosystem.
